about: The company goal, this quarter's objectives and their key results. Only the founder edits this file (the decision gate); agents propose new values with `python tools/goals.py update <key result> --value N` in a pull request. Objective ids look like O1, key result ids like O1.1. status: planned, active, achieved or cancelled. Progress is how far current has moved from baseline (0 if unset) to target. Slices and epics in slices.json name an objective with "objective": "O1"; tickets carry the label goal:O1.
goal: Prove that UK and EU platforms holding user balances will run their real payouts through DekernAI's payment controls, and sign the first paid pilot

objectives.title: Prove the pain with real platforms
objectives.why: Stages 1 and 2 have no evidence yet (status risk 1). Source: docs/product/problem-validation.md, customer-discovery.md.

key_results.metric: Problem interviews with ICP payments leads, notes logged
Interviews confirming H1 and H2 unprompted, with a recent example
Platforms agreeing to share a 30-day anonymised export

objectives.title: Turn interest into the first design partner
objectives.why: The business model rests on shadow report to pilot. Source: docs/product/business-model.md.

key_results.metric: Free shadow reports delivered on a real export
Follow-up demos (spec/11) given from the deployed EU instance
Strategy stages decided by the founder: business model, product and operating model

objectives.title: Make the product demo-ready and integrable
objectives.why: Approved scope D-37: S9 then P1. Source: docs/product/mvp-scope.md.

key_results.metric: spec/11 runs end to end on the deployed EU instance on both Sepolias
P1 Sandbox API and webhooks acceptance criteria done

north_star.metric: Real platform payments decided by DekernAI per week (shadow or live)
north_star.why: Proposed. Counts value delivered on customers' own data, not demo runs: a payment only counts once a design partner's real export or live traffic is decided under their rules. Target is an assumption to revisit after discovery.

initiatives.title: Build a list of 20 ICP payments leads from the founder's network (no former-employer clients) and book 8 calls
Run the 25-minute problem interview script and log each one in docs/product/customer-discovery.md within 24 hours
Synthesise after 5 interviews: mark H1 to H8 confirmed or disproved; update the ICP
Ask every interviewee for a 30-day anonymised payout export at the end of the call
Define the shadow report format and produce it from an export with the existing import, decide and replay
Book a second meeting with compliance for each platform that shares an export, and demo from the deployed instance
Test a pilot fee range in second meetings, then run pricing-strategy with the evidence
Founder reviews and decides stages 3 and 5 from the strategy docs (Passed, Deferred or changes)
Close the S9 founder items: Render and Neon accounts, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, funded Sepolia wallets
Deploy to the EU region and run the live testnet demo; fix mismatches in spec/11
Build P1 story groups: keys and scopes, errors, versions, rate limits, request logs, then webhooks
